title: json5: rename the identifier helpers used by parse and stringify
prompt: This is a copy of json5 2.2.3 (lib/). lib/util.js exports `isIdStartChar` and `isIdContinueChar`. Rename them to `isIdentifierStart` and `isIdentifierPart` and update every module that calls them (the parser and the stringifier). The old names must be gone from lib/ and from the exports, and behaviour must be unchanged.
